items.title: Strategic Sourcing Lead, Professional Services – Human Data
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI Finance helps ensure the organization is positioned for long-term success as we pursue our mission. The Strategic Sourcing & Procurement team enables OpenAI to scale responsibly, securely, and at speed by helping teams choose the right external partners, structure strong commercial agreements, and build resilient supplier ecosystems. We work at the intersection of innovation and execution, partnering closely with leaders across the company to turn rapidly evolving needs into scalable, compliant, and economically sound solutions. Professional services are a critical source of specialized expertise, capacity, and operational leverage across OpenAI. Our work spans consulting and advisory services, finance and accounting, legal, people and talent, managed services, Human Data services, and other enterprise capabilities. Done well, sourcing becomes a source of trust and momentum—helping teams move faster with the right partners, clearer outcomes, stronger economics, and appropriate safeguards. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Strategic Sourcing Lead to own and execute OpenAI’s category strategy for Professional Services. This is an experienced individual-contributor role for a high-velocity, hands-on sourcing operator who can set category priorities, own complex work end to end, exercise sound judgment, influence senior stakeholders, and build scalable category mechanisms in a rapidly growing organization. You will turn incomplete information, shifting priorities, and unclear decision paths into practical next steps and disciplined execution. You will manage a broad portfolio of services engagements—from strategic advisory relationships and enterprise programs to high-volume statements of work. Partnering directly with leaders across Finance, Accounting, Legal, People, Extended Workforce, and business teams, you will set category priorities and translate needs into clear sourcing strategies, executable engagement models, and measurable outcomes. You will operate independently across multiple concurrent deals, knowing when to align, escalate, or redirect an approach to protect speed, value, and risk. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Own and continuously evolve the Professional Services category strategy and execution roadmap, setting priorities based on business needs, operating goals, market insight, and risk considerations. - Own multiple complex sourcing workstreams end to end, balancing high-value strategic negotiations with a high-throughput portfolio of services engagements. - Build trusted partnerships with senior stakeholders, clarify tradeoffs, and challenge or redirect proposed services models when a different approach will improve value, delivery, or risk. - Lead complex negotiations and design fit-for-purpose commercial structures, including master services agreements, statements of work, milestone- and outcome-based pricing, rate cards, acceptance criteria, change controls, audit rights, and termination protections. - Build and improve scalable category mechanisms, including intake and tiering, category plans, preferred-partner models, supplier segmentation, negotiation playbooks, approval pathways, and clear escalation mechanisms—creating enough structure to enable speed without over-engineering. - Strengthen the supplier ecosystem through competitive sourcing, consolidation where appropriate, performance governance, business reviews, and active value-realization plans. - Partner with Finance and Accounting to improve spend visibility, forecasting, approval discipline, invoice-to-contract alignment, and commercial structures that support appropriate accounting treatment and auditability. - Partner with Legal, People, and Extended Workforce to distinguish professional services from contingent labor, translate guidance into practical guardrails, and reduce co-employment, scope, intellectual-property, and delivery risk without slowing the business. - Produce clear, executive-ready reporting across pipeline health, savings and cost avoidance, cycle time, supplier performance, renewal exposure, risk, forecast accuracy, and realized business value. - Drive reliable execution through disciplined follow-through, clear documentation, clean data, timely approvals, and practical process improvements—creating lightweight structure where gaps exist and adapting quickly as priorities change. - Use AI to redesign sourcing workflows—including intake, market and supplier analysis, negotiation preparation, contract and spend analysis, documentation, reporting, and decision support—to improve speed, consistency, and decision quality while maintaining appropriate human judgment and controls. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or category management, with significant depth in Professional Services. - Have owned Professional Services category strategy and sourcing end to end—from intake and competitive sourcing through contracting, governance, renewals, and long-term supplier strategy. - Have led complex, high-stakes services negotiations and can balance cost, speed, flexibility, quality, risk, and long-term partnership value. - Understand the commercial and operating dynamics of consulting, advisory, managed services, and project-based work, including the boundaries between professional services, contingent labor, and full-time hiring. - Have helped build or improve category operating mechanisms—such as intake, tiering, preferred-partner models, playbooks, reporting, or supplier governance—and can balance standardization with flexibility. - Have demonstrated experience using AI to redesign sourcing workflows and can show how it improved speed, insight, decision quality, or stakeholder experience while preserving appropriate human review and controls. - Influence senior stakeholders through trust, structured thinking, sound judgment, and clear communication of tradeoffs; know when to move independently and when to align or escalate. - Bring strong financial and analytical fluency, and can turn imperfect spend, supplier, and performance data into clear decisions and measurable business outcomes. - Operate effectively through ambiguity, rapid change, and limited structure; turn incomplete data and evolving decision rights into clear actions, and adjust your approach to different company stages, operating models, and organizational cultures. - Are a scrappy, hands-on operator who combines ownership, accountability, humility, and team-first collaboration; you are willing to do the work now and have the range to help shape and lead a flexible team over time. You will manage senior functional leaders across equity and payroll, and partner closely with Legal, Tax, HR, and the broader Accounting organization to support our mission to make AI beneficial for humanity. Drive systems strategy across the compensation platforms, from equity to payroll, and surrounding integrations, ensuring a coherent architecture as we scale Serve as the primary escalation point and executive interface for equity and payroll matters with Legal, Tax, HR, and external providers Oversee international expansion of both functions, including new-country payroll setup, cross-border equity compliance, and mobility programs Partner with Accounting on stock-based compensation and payroll accounting, ensuring clean handoffs for close, reporting, and audit Drive automation and continuous improvement of manual processes across both teams through technology solutions Build headcount and resourcing plans that scale with the business YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU Have 15+ years across equity compensation and/or payroll operations, with significant experience leading senior functional leaders Have operated equity and payroll functions to a public company standard. Have deep familiarity with equity management platforms (such as Shareworks or E*TRADE) and Workday payroll, with experience owning cross-system architecture Have built and scaled global operations across multiple jurisdictions Are a strong people leader who develops senior functional experts Thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and default to building scalable processes over adding headcount STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO Hold CEP (Certified Equity Professional) or CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) certification Have experience with international mobility programs, worker secondments, and cross-border tax considerations Have led complex system implementations or migrations at scale The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. Annual Salary: $570,000 — $610,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. items.title: Payment Operations Analyst
items.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team The Payment Operations team powers the accurate, timely, and secure movement of funds across the entire Raisin U.S. platform. As a multi-bank deposit marketplace supporting high-yield savings accounts, CDs, and a centralized cash account, Raisin facilitates inbound and outbound ACH transactions, reinvestments, and internal money movement across partner banks, custodial banks, and service bank relationships. Payment Operations owns the end-to-end payment lifecycle: transaction processing, multi-entity settlement, ledger reconciliation, exception resolution, and operational risk mitigation. The team works hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Custodial and Service Banks and other partners to build scalable financial infrastructure. As Raisin expands, we are focused on designing a flexible operational architecture capable of supporting a broader multi-rail payment ecosystem. Your Responsibilities The Payment Operations Analyst will be responsible for the day to day execution and operational effectiveness of payments processes, payment accuracy, timeliness and reconciliation, across all of our deposit products. In this role, the analyst will work closely with the engineering and the product team to identify issues and address them on a timely basis to ensure timely and accurate payment processing, and reconciliation. This role, given the need for accurate, timely payments and ledger accuracy expectations, requires individuals who are self driven, display great accountability for their work, and can operate with autonomy. Display high accountability to payment process timeliness, accuracy and reconciliation. Reconcile accounts and resolve payment-related issues promptly and accurately, ensuring timely payment processing. Be proactive in identifying payment processing or reconciliation issues, escalate appropriately, and take accountability to working with required operating partners to resolve the issue. Monitor payment processing activity diligently to identify and address any signs of fraudulent or suspicious behavior. Analyze existing operational processes, identify areas for enhancement, and develop actionable recommendations to optimize efficiency. Collaborate closely with engineering, product, service, partner banks, service bank and custodial banks to resolve payment and reconciliation issues and to implement process and productivity improvements. Establish, monitor and achieve critical payment operations success metrics. Identify opportunities for payment process automation and partner with product and engineering teams to implement automation solutions. Conduct data analysis to generate valuable insights and provide strategic recommendations to leadership. Support customer service and finance teams by addressing operational inquiries and issues effectively. Create, follow and maintain precise and comprehensive documentation for operational processes and procedures. Your Profile Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field. Strong knowledge of financial products, services, regulations, and compliance. 2+ years of experience in operations analysis or a similar role within the fintech or financial services industry. Meticulous and extremely detail oriented approach to work. Exceptional analytical skills to evaluate complex data and provide actionable recommendations. Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements. Proficiency in process automation and data visualization tools such as Excel, Looker, SQL, etc. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to excel both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Flexible working hours and up to 28 days PTO accrued from your first month, plus 13 public holidays. Employee Development Budget of $2,200 and 4 full training days per year. Company 401k contribution of 5%. Healthcare coverage contribution, including medical, dental and vision. Commuter benefits and flexible working from home policy. Regular team events and yearly Summer and Winter Party. Salary Range $80,000 — $100,000 USD Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

items.title: Financial Accountant
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Legend is hiring a Financial Accountant, reporting to our Senior Financial Reporting Manager in Holbern, London. The Financial Reporting team sits at the heart of our global Finance function, ensuring the business has accurate, reliable and insightful financial information while continually improving how we report, analyse and use data. As a Financial Accountant, you'll take ownership across key areas of the financial reporting cycle, working across the balance sheet, P&L and cash flow to ensure our financial outputs are accurate, well-controlled and delivered to a high standard. Alongside strong accounting fundamentals, we're looking for someone who is naturally analytical and enjoys finding better ways of doing things. You'll use data, automation and process improvement to make our reporting more efficient, reduce manual work and improve the quality of financial insight available to the business. This is an opportunity to combine hands-on financial reporting with analysis and continuous improvement within a fast-paced, multinational listed business undergoing significant growth and change. Your Impact: Take ownership of key areas of the monthly, quarterly and year-end financial reporting cycle, ensuring accurate and timely delivery. Prepare, review and improve balance sheet reconciliations, supporting schedules and working papers, investigating and resolving issues where required. Analyse financial performance across the balance sheet, P&L and cash flow, identifying trends, investigating variances and highlighting risks or opportunities. Build, improve and automate reporting processes using Excel and other data tools, reducing manual effort and improving the accuracy and efficiency of financial reporting. Use data and financial insight to challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and improve how Finance operates. Partner with Finance Operations, FP&A and wider Finance teams to improve the quality, consistency and usefulness of financial information. Support audit, governance and control activities throughout the financial reporting cycle. Contribute to wider Finance projects and improvements as the function continues to evolve and scale following Legend's acquisition. What You'll Bring: Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent). Relevant experience within financial reporting, management accounting or a similar industry finance environment, with the ability to independently own areas of the reporting cycle. Strong understanding of financial reporting fundamentals and experience working across the balance sheet, P&L and cash flow. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret financial data, investigate issues and turn information into meaningful insight. Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with complex financial data and large datasets. Demonstrable experience improving reporting processes, automating manual tasks or finding more efficient ways of working. Experience with Power Query, Alteryx or similar data tools would be highly advantageous. Excellent attention to detail with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and producing high-quality financial information. A proactive and curious mindset, with the confidence to challenge existing processes and take ownership of problems through to resolution. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance and the wider business. Experience within a fast-paced, multinational or listed environment, or exposure to post-acquisition change, would be advantageous but is not essential. The Interview Process: Interview with the Talent Partner (30 mins via Zoom) 1 hour zoom Interview with the Senior Financial Reporting Manager and People Partner Final interview with the Head of Financial Reporting and the Financial Controller (1 hour via Zoom) Additional Information When you apply for a role with Legend through the Genius Sports careers site, the information you provide as part of your application will initially be collected through Genius Sports' recruitment software provider, Greenhouse, on our behalf and for our purposes only. Your application and related personal data may then be transferred to our recruitment platform, Lever, where it will be processed in accordance with our privacy notice, which you can find here https://l1.com/privacy-policy Legend is an Equal Opportunity Employer, but that’s just the start. We believe different perspectives help us grow and achieve more. That’s why we’re dedicated to hiring and developing the most talented and diverse team- which includes individuals with different backgrounds, abilities, identities and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments throughout your application process, please speak to your Talent Partner or contact the team on talent@l1.com , and we'll do all we can to support you.

items.title: FP&A Manager
items.description: About Legend Legend is a world-leading sports and gaming media network, reaching hundreds of millions of visitors a year. We're now part of Genius Sports. Together, we’re combining Legend’s audience, brands and product expertise with Genius Sports’ real-time data, technology and capabilities to create the next generation of fan-facing media and advertising Here at Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company. Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive. The Role Legend is hiring an FP&A Manager to join our Commercial Finance team and become a key Finance Business Partner to our iGaming business. This is an individual contributor role with significant ownership and influence. Working closely with our Principal FP&A Lead and partnering directly with the Head of iGaming and his leadership team, you’ll help shape commercial decisions across a complex portfolio of products, markets and investments. We’re looking for someone who can go beyond reporting performance. You’ll get underneath the numbers, understand what is driving them and use that insight to challenge thinking, identify opportunities and recommend where we should act, invest or change direction. You’ll bring together financial and operational data to develop a clear point of view on business performance. Whether assessing an investment opportunity, understanding movements in EBITDA, challenging a forecast or evaluating performance across products and markets, we’ll expect you to turn your analysis into recommendations that help the business make better decisions. You’ll also need strong FP&A fundamentals. You’ll be comfortable owning financial models, forecasts, budgets and scenario analysis and getting into the detail when required. The difference at this level is what you do with that information: connecting the dots, influencing senior stakeholders and helping turn insight into action. This could suit an experienced FP&A or Commercial Finance professional who has already built strong technical foundations and is now looking for a role where they can have greater commercial ownership and influence. Your Impact: Be a trusted Finance Business Partner to our iGaming leadership, building a deep understanding of the business and using financial insight to challenge, influence and support commercial decision-making. Turn performance into action, analysing the P&L as well as operational and commercial KPIs to identify the underlying drivers of performance and recommend what the business should do next. Shape investment and commercial decisions, building financial models, business cases and scenario analysis to assess opportunities, trade-offs, risks and returns and help determine where we should invest our resources. Own and continuously improve forecasting and planning, bringing together financial, operational and commercial assumptions to create robust forecasts while constructively challenging the assumptions behind them. Proactively identify opportunities and risks, using data and your understanding of the business to surface issues early, investigate their root causes and drive conversations around potential actions. Influence through insight, presenting clear recommendations to senior finance and non-finance stakeholders and being comfortable constructively challenging established thinking when the data points to a different conclusion. Drive better decision-making across the Gaming business, partnering with Product, Commercial, Marketing and Data teams to connect financial performance with the operational decisions behind it. Raise the standard of FP&A, identifying opportunities to improve our models, reporting, processes and use of data so Finance can spend less time producing information and more time influencing decisions. What You'll Bring: A fully qualified accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) alongside strong FP&A or Commercial Finance experience. Demonstrable experience operating as a Finance Business Partner, working with senior non-finance stakeholders and influencing commercial decisions. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move beyond explaining the numbers to developing a clear point of view and recommending a course of action. Examples of where your analysis has directly influenced a decision, investment, change in direction or improvement in business performance. Strong financial modelling, forecasting and scenario-planning capability, with advanced Excel skills and the confidence to build and interrogate models independently. Strong understanding of P&L and EBITDA performance and the ability to connect financial outcomes with operational and commercial drivers. The confidence to constructively challenge senior stakeholders, test assumptions and ask difficult questions while building strong, trusted relationships. A proactive and curious approach, you don’t wait to be asked for analysis when you can see an opportunity, risk or question worth investigating. The ability to take complex financial and operational information and communicate the key message and recommendation clearly and concisely. Experience working in a fast-paced, commercially complex environment; experience within iGaming, gaming, digital media, technology or another data-rich consumer business would be advantageous.
